title: Add second subcontractor (Local Assembly) to Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data
summary: Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data now includes a second subcontractor (Local Assembly) alongside the renamed Bulk Assembly subcontractor, with corresponding work centers, locations, and routing updates to support dual-sourcing scenarios.
key_points: Renamed existing subcontractor to Bulk Assembly (vendor 82000, work center 500, location S82000)
Added second subcontractor Local Assembly (vendor 83000, work center 600, location S83000)
Created inventory posting setup entries for both subcontracting locations
Updated manufacturing routing to point work center 500 to work center 600 with adjusted capacity (100 to 40)
Demo data is forward-only; existing databases retain original records unless explicitly overwritten
quote: Modern SCM demos need dual-sourcing across multiple subcontractors.
